result.markdown: --- title: "[bootstrap()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Bootstrap confidence interval for a Kaplan-Meier summary statistic. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/greenwood/blob/main/greenwood/_bootstrap.py#L272-L489){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python bootstrap( surv, statistic, *, data=None, by=None, weights=None, n_boot=1000, conf_level=0.95, ci_type="percentile", seed=None, tau=None, p=None, times=None ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Resamples subjects with replacement, fits a Kaplan-Meier estimator on each resample, and extracts the statistic of interest. The bootstrap distribution is then used to construct a confidence interval. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [surv]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Surv | Outcome | str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A `Surv` response (right-censored or counting-process). An `Outcome` or a formula string such as `'Surv(time, status == 2) ~ sex'` is also accepted, with its columns read from `data`. The right-hand side names the `group` column(s). [statistic]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | Callable[[KaplanMeier], float]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The quantity to bootstrap. Pass a string for built-in statistics: - `"median"`: median survival time. - `"rmst"`: restricted mean survival time (requires `tau=`). - `"quantile"`: survival quantile (requires `p=`). - `"survival"`: survival probability at a fixed time (requires `times=`). - `"median_diff"`: difference in median survival between two groups (requires `by=`). - `"rmst_diff"`: difference in RMST between two groups (requires `by=` and `tau=`). - `"survival_diff"`: difference in survival probability at a fixed time between two groups (requires `by=` and `times=`). Alternatively, pass a callable that takes a fitted `KaplanMeier` and returns a float. [by]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Any]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Grouping variable for two-sample comparisons. Required for `"_diff"` statistics. Must define exactly two groups. [weights]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Any]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional case weights passed through to each bootstrap KM fit. [n_boot]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[1000]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Number of bootstrap replicates (default 1000). [conf_level]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0.95]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Confidence level (default 0.95). [ci_type]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["percentile"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Confidence interval type: `"percentile"` (default), `"normal"`, or `"bca"` (bias-corrected and accelerated). [seed]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Random seed for reproducibility. [tau]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Upper time limit for RMST statistics. [p]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Quantile level for `"quantile"` statistic. [times]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Time point for `"survival"` and `"survival_diff"` statistics. [data]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Any]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : A data frame (pandas, Polars, PyArrow, DuckDB, a lazy frame, ...) holding the columns named by the response, `by`, and `weights`. When `surv`{.gd-no-link} is an `Outcome` or a formula, rows with a missing value in any column used are dropped first, along with the matching rows of any arrays passed alongside. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [BootstrapResult]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Point estimate, standard error, confidence interval, and the full bootstrap distribution. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Bootstrap a 95% percentile confidence interval for the median survival time: ::: {#63415f0e .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import greenwood as gw lung = gw.load_dataset("lung", backend="polars") death = gw.Outcome.surv(time="time", event="status") gw.bootstrap(death, statistic="median", n_boot=500, seed=0, data=lung) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` BootstrapResult (n_boot=500, ci_type='percentile') estimate se 0.95LCL 0.95UCL 310.000 23.330 283.475 363.000 ``` ::: ::: Bootstrap the difference in restricted mean survival time (RMST) between two groups. The formula's right-hand side defines the grouping variable (the same as `by="sex"`) and `tau=` sets the time horizon: ::: {#51d4d6c9 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} gw.bootstrap( "Surv(time, status) ~ sex", statistic="rmst_diff", tau=365, n_boot=500, seed=0, data=lung, ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` BootstrapResult (n_boot=500, ci_type='percentile') estimate se 0.95LCL 0.95UCL -55.970 14.961 -83.607 -25.160 ``` ::: ::: Use a BCa (bias-corrected and accelerated) interval for better small-sample coverage: ::: {#fa09d1e7 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} gw.bootstrap( death, statistic="median", n_boot=500, ci_type="bca", seed=0, data=lung ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` BootstrapResult (n_boot=500, ci_type='bca') estimate se 0.95LCL 0.95UCL 310.000 23.330 269.000 353.000 ``` ::: :::
